name: Required Input
description: Provide the input data archive containing output files from one or more bioinformatics tools. MultiQC will automatically detect and parse all recognized file types.

name: Report Settings
description: Customize the appearance and content of the HTML report, including its title, comment annotation, and output filename.

name: Module Selection
description: Control which bioinformatics tool modules are included in or excluded from the report. Leave blank to auto-detect all supported tools.

name: Output Options
description: Configure output data format, plot rendering style, image export, and sample naming for the generated report.

name: Advanced Configuration
description: Advanced settings for expert users. Supply a custom MultiQC YAML configuration file or provide inline YAML configuration overrides to fine-tune report behavior.
